items.stem: What is the correct way to reuse a consistent background and placeholder set across many slides?

options.text: Edit the slide master and its layouts
options.rationale: Correct: editing the slide master and layouts applies consistent design across slides.
Manual reformatting is error-prone and not reusable.

options.text: Group all shapes on one slide
options.rationale: Grouping shapes on one slide does not affect others.

options.text: Apply a transition to every slide
options.rationale: Transitions control slide changes, not shared design.

items.explanation: Correct: editing the slide master and layouts applies consistent design across slides.

items.stem: Which feature controls how one slide advances to the next during a slideshow?

options.rationale: Correct: transitions control movement between slides.
Animations control movement of objects within a slide.
A hyperlink jumps to a target; it is not the slide-advance effect.
A comment is a review note, not a playback effect.

items.explanation: Correct: transitions control movement between slides.

items.stem: Select TWO objects you can insert from the 'Insert tables, charts, SmartArt, 3D models, and media' domain.

options.rationale: Correct: a chart is an insertable object in this domain.
Correct: a video clip is insertable media in this domain.
A slide transition is a playback effect, not an inserted object.
A speaker note is presentation text, not an inserted media object.
